requirements.definition: The subclause applies to an actual argument with the ALLOCATABLE or POINTER attribute that corresponds to a dummy argument with the same attribute.

requirements.title: Polymorphism and declared type must correspond for allocatable or pointer actual and dummy arguments
requirements.definition: For ALLOCATABLE or POINTER actual and dummy arguments, the actual argument is polymorphic exactly in the cases where the associated dummy argument is polymorphic; both are unlimited polymorphic or the declared type of the actual is the same as the declared type of the dummy.

requirements.title: Rank must match unless the dummy argument is assumed-rank
requirements.definition: The rank of the actual argument is required to be the same as that of the dummy argument, apart from an assumed-rank dummy argument.
